source.title: Super Mario 3D All-Stars
source.summary: Super Mario 3D All-Stars is a 2020 platform game compilation developed and published by Nintendo for the Nintendo Switch.
body: Super Mario 3D All-Stars is a 2020 platform game compilation developed and published by Nintendo for the Nintendo Switch. It commemorates the 35th anniversary of Nintendo's Super Mario series, with ports of Super Mario 64 (1996), Super Mario Sunshine (2002), and Super Mario Galaxy (2007) in high-definition.

The compilation was released on September 18, 2020, and was available until March 31, 2021, when it was discontinued and removed from the Nintendo eShop. It received positive reviews for its games, technical improvements, and controls, but was criticized for its presentation, lack of additional content, time-limited release, and the absence of Super Mario Galaxy 2 (2010). As of March 2021, Super Mario 3D All-Stars had shipped more than 9 million copies worldwide, making it one of the best-selling video games of 2020.
story_headings: Three adventures for the thirty-fifth anniversary
A compilation with a limited release window

translation.title: Super Mario 3D All-Stars
translation.summary: Super Mario 3D All-Stars est une compilation de jeux de plateforme de 2020, développée et publiée par Nintendo sur Nintendo Switch.
story_headings: Trois aventures pour le trente-cinquième anniversaire
Une compilation disponible pour une durée limitée
body: Super Mario 3D All-Stars est une compilation de jeux de plateforme de 2020, développée et publiée par Nintendo sur Nintendo Switch. Elle célèbre le trente-cinquième anniversaire de la série Super Mario avec des portages en haute définition de Super Mario 64, paru en 1996, Super Mario Sunshine, sorti en 2002, et Super Mario Galaxy, de 2007.

La compilation sort le 18 septembre 2020 et reste disponible jusqu’au 31 mars 2021, date à laquelle sa distribution est arrêtée et où elle est retirée du Nintendo eShop. Les critiques apprécient les jeux, les améliorations techniques et les commandes, mais reprochent à l’ensemble sa présentation, son manque de contenu supplémentaire, sa disponibilité limitée et l’absence de Super Mario Galaxy 2, paru en 2010. En mars 2021, plus de neuf millions d’exemplaires avaient été distribués dans le monde, ce qui en fait l’un des jeux vidéo les plus vendus de 2020.

source.title: Art of Rally
source.summary: Art of Rally (stylized as art of rally) is a racing video game developed and published by Funselektor Labs.
body: Art of Rally (stylized as art of rally) is a racing video game developed and published by Funselektor Labs. The game was released on September 23, 2020 for Windows, macOS, and Linux; on August 12, 2021 for Xbox One, Xbox Series X/S, and Nintendo Switch; on October 6, 2021 for PlayStation 4 and PlayStation 5; and mobile ports published by Noodlecake were released for iOS on January 18, 2024 and Android on March 26, 2024. Art of Rally is set during the golden era of rally, in an alternate timeline where Group B was never discontinued. Players compete in rallies, unlocking classes and cars as they progress through the game.
Art of Rally received generally favorable reviews for Windows and Xbox, while the Switch version received mixed reviews.
story_headings: An alternative golden era of rally

source.title: Genshin Impact
source.summary: Genshin Impact  ( GHEN-shin; Chinese: 原神; pinyin: Yuánshén; lit. 'Primordial God') is a 2020 action role-playing video game developed and published by miHoYo.
body: Genshin Impact  ( GHEN-shin; Chinese: 原神; pinyin: Yuánshén; lit. 'Primordial God') is a 2020 action role-playing video game developed and published by miHoYo. It is distributed outside China by miHoYo's international subsidiary Cognosphere, also known as HoYoverse. At its core, the game features an anime style, open-world environment, an action-focused battle system consisting of elemental magic with character-switching, and a mythical main story. Genshin Impact is a free-to-play game monetized through gacha mechanics, which is updated regularly using the games as a service model. It was originally released for Android, iOS, PlayStation 4, and Windows, followed by the PlayStation 5 in 2021, and Xbox Series X/S in 2024. In China, a native port for HarmonyOS NEXT was released in September 2025. Support for PlayStation 4 was removed in April 2026.

Genshin Impact takes inspiration from a variety of sources, including the game The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild, anime, Gnosticism, and an array of real-world cultures and mythologies. The game takes place in the fantasy world of Teyvat, home to seven nations each tied to a different element and ruled by individual gods called "Archons". The story follows the Traveler, an interstellar adventurer who is separated from their twin sibling after the two land in Teyvat. Together with their guide Paimon, the Traveler journeys across the nations of Teyvat in search of their lost sibling. Along the way, the two make friends with Teyvat's people, become involved in the affairs of its nations, and unravel the mysteries of the land.

Genshin Impact has received generally positive reviews, with critics praising its combat mechanics and open-world system, but some criticism has been directed at its endgame and its monetization model. The game has also been involved in controversies over censorship of content related to Chinese politics, as well as privacy and security concerns. The game performed very well commercially; at its fourth anniversary in 2024, PocketGamer.biz reported AppMagic estimates of US$6.3 billion in gross revenue on the App Store and Google Play, not total revenue across all platforms. It has received several awards, including Best Mobile Game at the Game Awards 2021 and Still Playing Award at the 2023 Golden Joystick Awards.
story_headings: An open world of elements and characters

translation.title: Genshin Impact
translation.summary: Genshin Impact, en chinois 原神 (Yuánshén, littéralement « dieu primordial »), est un jeu de rôle d’action de 2020 développé et publié par miHoYo.
story_headings: Un monde ouvert entre éléments et personnages
body: Genshin Impact, en chinois 原神 (Yuánshén, littéralement « dieu primordial »), est un jeu de rôle d’action de 2020 développé et publié par miHoYo. Hors de Chine, sa distribution est assurée par Cognosphere, filiale internationale de miHoYo également connue sous le nom HoYoverse. Le jeu associe une esthétique anime, un monde ouvert, des combats d’action mêlant magie élémentaire et changement de personnage, ainsi qu’un récit principal mythologique. Gratuit, il se finance par des mécanismes de gacha et reçoit des mises à jour régulières selon le modèle du jeu-service. Il sort d’abord sur Android, iOS, PlayStation 4 et Windows, puis sur PlayStation 5 en 2021 et Xbox Series X/S en 2024. Un portage natif pour HarmonyOS NEXT paraît en Chine en septembre 2025. La prise en charge de la PlayStation 4 cesse en avril 2026.

Genshin Impact puise dans de nombreuses sources, parmi lesquelles The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild, l’animation japonaise, le gnosticisme et diverses cultures et mythologies du monde réel. Il se déroule dans le monde fantastique de Teyvat, qui abrite sept nations, chacune liée à un élément et gouvernée par une divinité appelée « Archon ». L’histoire suit le Voyageur, un aventurier interstellaire séparé de son jumeau après leur arrivée à Teyvat. Accompagné de sa guide Paimon, il traverse les nations à la recherche de ce proche disparu. Tous deux se lient aux habitants, se trouvent mêlés aux affaires des différentes nations et découvrent les mystères de cette terre.

Genshin Impact reçoit un accueil généralement favorable pour ses combats et son monde ouvert, mais ses activités de fin de jeu et son modèle économique suscitent des critiques. Il est aussi au centre de controverses concernant la censure de contenus liés à la politique chinoise, ainsi que la confidentialité et la sécurité. Ses résultats commerciaux sont très élevés : à son quatrième anniversaire, en 2024, PocketGamer.biz rapporte une estimation d’AppMagic de 6,3 milliards de dollars de revenus bruts sur l’App Store et Google Play, et non de revenus totaux toutes plateformes confondues. Il reçoit notamment le prix du Meilleur jeu mobile aux The Game Awards 2021 et le Still Playing Award aux Golden Joystick Awards 2023.
